title: Mitsubishi Eclipse Engines by Year (1990–2012)
description: Every factory engine in the Mitsubishi Eclipse by year, 1990–2012: the 4G63 turbo and other fours, the Chrysler 420A, and the 3.0 and 3.8 V6s.
intro: The Eclipse was built in Illinois from 1990 to 2012. The first two generations shared their engines with the Plymouth Laser and Eagle Talon.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: First generation
intro: The 1.8 4G37, the 2.0 4G63 and the 4G63 turbo, also in the all-wheel-drive GSX.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The Chrysler 2.0 420A, the 4G63 turbo, and the 2.4 4G64 in the Spyder GS.
